title: Rookery Pointe Estero FL: What Does the HOA Fee Actually Cover? 2026
excerpt: Detached homes in Rookery Pointe pay one HOA fee of $1,545 a quarter, covering internet and cable TV, lawn care, irrigation water, the gate, amenities, management, and reserves. There is no CDD on Lee County's list and no golf bill, so that fee is close to the whole recurring community cost.
